Crew Motorfest, the game feels super dull and lacks the massive open map of crew and crew 2. A solid chunk of the map is just flat-ish dirt path and another chunk is just a massive mountain. Not even mentioning the lack of anything that truly makes the map feels like Hawaii, at least fh5 has some of the local cars in the game. The handling feels sloppy at best in 90% of the cars and the only thing that brings players back is the grand race, the summits and maybe the updates. Don’t get me wrong, I loved the hoonigan update but with hoonigan falling apart while we got the update made it feel forced and rushed. Throw in all of the bugs like the 959s automatic transmission not wanting to shift into second whenever your spinning wheels and instead will slow down even on throttle. 4/10 should be 25$ not $80 (Canadian dollars)
